resources.string: Used for YFloat view recognition, system gestures, and user-triggered accessibility screenshots. In YSuite, enable the YFloat service rather than the YNotify accessibility service.
Fine-tune Google Circle selection visuals and YFloat recognition. Google styles apply on the next marked session.
Requires the Google LSPosed scope and an active YFloat-controlled Circle session. Ordinary YUI sizing remains in unified appearance settings.
Replace the Google rainbow effect with YUI\'s YFloat border color.
These are YFloat-specific behavior thresholds, not general UI dimensions.
Choose Google native Circle to Search or YFloat Native V3. Google requires LSPosed scope and a supported Google App. An unsupported session falls back to Native V3.
Google 17.58: legacy compatibility; the 17.60 mapping is preferred.
Google 17.64 is not enabled in the 17.60-based Hook; using Native V3.
Unverified Google version: experimental 17.60-based Hook discovery; compatibility not guaranteed.
Google 17.60: preferred Hook baseline. Device verification is still required.
Google 17.58: legacy compatibility mode. Primary development targets 17.60.

Force a fresh Hook match for the installed Google App; needs Root and LSPosed. Automatically turns off. The Google app opens to finish scanning.
Google Hook rescan started. Result will appear in a Toast.
Root permission is required to restart Google and scan immediately.
Enable LSPosed enhancement and Google App scope before scanning.
A Google Hook scan is already pending.
Google was restarted but could not be opened. Launch Google manually to complete scanning.
Timeout: Google Hook did not return a result; check LSPosed scope and diagnostic logs.
Google Hook scan in progress (up to 45 seconds)
Google process did not report an active LSPosed Hook; verify target scope, process injection, and Google module logs.
Waiting for Google LSPosed Hook injection (not scanning yet)

No scan callback arrived from the Google process. LSPosed scope is configured, but target injection and bridge IPC cannot be distinguished without module logs. Check YSuite.Xposed and YFloat-GoogleV2 in LSPosed logs.
Google Hook entered %1$s (%2$d/%3$d) but did not finish. Check LSPosed module logs for the Google target process.
